request: How many drivers of company Accenture for each cycle? visualize in bar chart and line chart
sql_query:
select
    cc2."name" as cycle_name,
    count(d.id) as driver_count
from ctre_program cp
    inner join programs_products pp on pp.program_id = cp.id
    inner join product_versions pv on pv.id = pp.product_version_id
    inner join ctre_company cc on cc.id = cp.company_id
    inner join ctre_cycle cc2 on cc2.program_id = cp.id
    
    inner join drivers d on d.product_version_id = pv.id
where 1=1
    and cc."name" = 'Accenture'
group by cc2."name"
order by cc2."name"
;
